note: Vatican City is not drawn on the map, so its record is tied to Italy. Russia has more people than Germany but is not in the European Union.
approvalRule: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {id, name, fact, caveat, disputed} (JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8). If any of these change, the approval no longer matches and the card must be re-approved before it is shown.

fact.ru: Россия — самая большая по площади страна в мире.
fact.en: Russia is the largest country in the world by area.

fact.ru: Внутри Рима находится Ватикан — самое маленькое государство в мире.
fact.en: Inside Rome lies Vatican City, the smallest country in the world.

fact.ru: Германия — самая населённая страна Европейского союза.
fact.en: Germany has the largest population in the European Union.
